summary: Iteration 6: Boating capacity (150) + sadhya/boating clash rule fully verified. 7/7 pytest cases pass and frontend correctly renders 'Full' + disabled state for a fully-booked boating slot while showing 'N seats left' for available slots. Bookings collection cleaned to empty at end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1190 lines — should be split into routers/services modules for maintainability.

assign_sadhya_slots picks the earliest compatible slot deterministically, which is correct per spec. Confirmed clash math: boat 11:00-11:45 -> 12:30 (11:30 blocked by <30min gap); boat 2:00-2:45 -> 11:30; boat 1:00-1:45 -> 11:30. Consistent with spec.
Boating capacity check counts only status='confirmed' bookings (correct); slots_availability counts confirmed for boating and confirmed+pending for sadhya, which is consistent.
seed_data_creation: Seeded a status=confirmed booking (ref TEST-SEED-B12 in pytest and TEST-SEED-UI-FULL for UI test) with 145/150 persons on 12:00 PM boating slot. Both cleaned up in teardown. Final DB verified empty (0 bookings).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 all green. Boating 45-min slots with capacity=150 and 30-min sadhya/boating gap rule are working end-to-end. Test file test_iteration6_boating_clash_capacity.py can be re-run any time; it is self-contained with its own seed+cleanup. pytest.ini added at /app/backend/tests/ enabling auto asyncio mode.
